# Governance

Human Rounds is an AGPL open-source project owned and stewarded by Generated
Media, Inc. The project uses a maintainer-led model: contributors are invited
to build consensus, while named maintainers remain accountable for decisions
and the safety of accepted changes.

## Decision making

Routine technical and product decisions are made in public project discussion
and resolved by the maintainers. The lead maintainer, Ivan Boyko, makes the
final call when consensus cannot be reached or when a timely decision is
required. Decisions must preserve the AGPL Core and Enterprise boundary in
[LICENSING.md](../docs/policies/LICENSING.md).

Generated Media, Inc. decides ownership, trademarks, commercial offerings and
the licensing of material it owns. That corporate role is separate from the
day-to-day maintainer role.

## Roles

- **Project owner:** Generated Media, Inc. owns and stewards Human Rounds.
- **Lead maintainer:** Ivan Boyko sets product and technical direction,
  resolves deadlocks and coordinates releases.
- **Maintainer:** Pavel Malai reviews and accepts changes, helps preserve the
  architecture and may represent the project in technical collaboration.
- **Contributors:** anyone making code, documentation, testing, design or
  operational contributions under the repository's contribution terms.

Maintainer status does not transfer project ownership or create employment,
support, availability or service-level obligations.

## Approvals and review

The review depth follows the risk. Ordinary changes require maintainer review
and green automated checks. Security, privacy, data-governance and clinical
safety changes also require review by an appropriate specialist. A maintainer
must not approve a change when they have an undisclosed material conflict of
interest.

Public releases require a reviewed release candidate, the documented release
gates, and approval from the lead maintainer. Commercial or proprietary work
must follow the boundary in `LICENSING.md` and cannot silently move an existing
AGPL component out of Core.

## Changes to this document

Generated Media, Inc. may amend this governance model after maintainer review.
Material changes to ownership, licensing, maintainer authority or release
approval are documented in the repository before they take effect.
